howItWorks.title: How WeCare works
howItWorks.intro: Four steps from your problem to the right solution.

choose.title: Choose your main problem
choose.description: Start with the area that affects you — sleep, pain, stress or migraine.

assessment.title: Answer a short assessment

match.title: Get matched with a suitable solution

continue.title: Continue to product, support or follow-up

solutionsPreview.title: Simple recommendations. No confusing catalog.

solutionsPreview.narrowNote: From hundreds of products down to what fits you.
